reason: policy: high-risk change (1 violation(s); require_approval by high_impact_paths)
summary: Reliability and hardening per the approved plan: standard JSON errors everywhere, 503 on link-store outage, failed-token throttle, 16 KiB body limit, security headers, loopback-only Actuator metrics
decisions: Error contract: Existing ApiException codes stay authoritative; only framework errors (via their own status and headers) and unexpected exceptions are translated, with fixed messages (agent)

Token throttle: Counted in LinkController after the service reports invalid_token, keyed by getRemoteAddr(), one shared rolling 60 s window for stats and delete; the 11th wrong token gets 429; valid and missing tokens bypass it (agent)

Database outage: Only the redirect's required link lookup maps resource-failure, transient and cannot-create-transaction exceptions to 503 service_unavailable with Retry-After 5; click recording stays best-effort (agent)
Body limit: A filter on /api/** counts received bytes (stops at limit+1) and replays the buffered body; Content-Length above the limit is rejected early (agent)
Security headers: A highest-precedence filter that also runs on error dispatches, registered on the management child context through ManagementContextConfiguration as well (agent)
Metrics: One Micrometer timer shortener.redirects tagged only by outcome (302/404/410/5xx/other): its count is the outcome count and its timing the latency (agent)
Management server: Port 8081 bound to 127.0.0.1 exposing only health and metrics; verified unreachable from the LAN address (agent)
Configuration change: application.yml gains management and new shortener limits; properties are configurable so tests can use ephemeral ports (agent)
